title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts, permitting stocks, bonds, ETFs only
dek: Ireland's planned retail savings scheme will permit only listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs; crypto and derivatives are excluded as higher-risk products. The policy represents an explicit regulatory choice to keep crypto out of a flagship tax-incentivized investment vehicle in an EU jurisdiction.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Ireland is barring cryptocurrency from its new tax-advantaged investment account scheme, limiting eligible assets to stocks, bonds, and ETFs.
body: Ireland's planned tax-advantaged investment accounts will include stocks, bonds, and ETFs, according to reporting from CoinDesk and Cointelegraph. Cryptocurrency and derivatives have been excluded from the scheme as higher-risk products. Account providers will handle tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.
The policy represents an explicit regulatory decision to keep crypto out of a flagship retail savings incentive.
